maya: Quick heads-up — i'm going to push v1.4.0-rc.2 to the staging tag in ~30m. Can folks sanity-check artifacts + changelog bump? pinging @ben @olivia :eyes:
ben: on it. i'll verify SHA checksums and the linux wheel contents.
olivia: will do a quick smoke on the docker image and the changelog entries. nothing too deep, just sanity.
maya: thanks. main things to confirm:
- annotated tag created
- artifacts uploaded to GH release draft
- checksums in release notes match artifacts
- changelog has the new subsections (breaking, features, fixes)

carmen: small note — if the changelog entry references internal config keys, please redact before publishing. we had one leak in rc.1. :grimacing:
ben: checksum commands i'm running:```bash
sha256sum build/*.tar.gz > sha256.txt
sha256sum docker/image.tar > sha256-docker.txt
cat sha256*.txt
```
ben: values look good locally, hashes match the upload manifest. i'll paste the first 2 lines in a sec.
release-bot: Draft release created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/edit/1.4.0-rc.2 (auto-draft by release pipeline) :page_with_curl:
maya: perfect — can someone confirm the annotated tag message includes the changelog excerpt? i prefer the tag note be small and point to the draft release rather than embed the full changelog.
olivia: checked the docker image: health check binary present, `rwd-server --version` prints `v1.4.0-rc.2`. no stray sensitive strings.
ben: pasted checksums:```
6a1f2b...  build/redwood-1.4.0-rc.2.tar.gz
9f3e4c...  build/redwood-wheel-1.4.0rc2.whl
```
ben: also verified artifact sizes match what CI reported.
maya: excellent. one more: are we okay with the branch cutoff? has anything landing after 1965100000 broken older tests?
carmen: only one minor doc tweak landed, no code changes. safe to cut.
maya: okay i'm going to run the tag-and-draft step now:```bash
git tag -a v1.4.0-rc.2 -m "v1.4.0-rc.2 — staging draft; see GH draft for notes" git push origin v1.4.0-rc.2
# then `./scripts/publish-draft-release --tag v1.4.0-rc.2`
```
release-bot: Tag v1.4.0-rc.2 pushed to origin by maya. Draft release updated. (artifact sync in progress) :rocket:
maya: pushed. please give it a minute for the artifact sync. i'll update when checksums are present in the draft notes.
olivia: if everything looks green in 15m i'll approve to mark the draft as ready-for-publish.
ben: thumbs on checksum and artifacts. no blockers from my side. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all. if anyone sees a bad checksum or missing file, @maya please DM immediately and i'll roll the tag back. otherwise plan to flip the draft to final in ~20-30m after another quick pass. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
